design.clustered_limit: exact Clopper-Pearson limit computed at the design-effect adjusted effective sample size
design.effective_sample_justification: The clustering unit is the mechanism family and every case has its own PRNG stream, workspace and contract hash.  The report gives the case-level exact limit, the Kish design-effect adjusted effective sample size and its limit, every family's own exact limit, and the worst single-family contribution.  A reviewer can therefore reject the independence claim and still read the conservative bound.
design.family_level_limit: the pessimistic 'one whole family is broken' bound, reported so that the residual risk of a mechanism-shaped blind spot is visible
design.independence_argument: Every case draws its randomness from its own PRNG stream, seeded from (seed, case_id), so no two cases share a random draw; the mechanism family is a randomised covariate rather than a block; every case is materialised in its own workspace, so no case can influence another; and the only shared component is the verifier itself, which is a systematic effect on the rate rather than a sampling covariance.  The case-level Clopper-Pearson limit is therefore the valid bound for the corpus.  The clustered and family-level analyses are reported next to it so that a reviewer can see what the claim would look like under the pessimistic assumption that a whole family is broken.
design.randomisation_unit: one independent PRNG stream per case

excluded_cases.mechanism: the required test is skipped; pytest exits zero, so an exit-code based selector treats the requirement as met
excluded_cases.owner: the deterministic check executor, not the contract gate

family_level.note: the worst-family figures bound the overall rate under the pessimistic assumption that one whole mechanism family is broken at the level its own sample size cannot rule out

notes: A case counts as a false accept when the gate accepts a case whose request was not satisfied; it counts as a false reject when the gate does not accept a case whose request was satisfied.
The corpus exercises the contract gate.  It cannot certify the rest of the system, so the exact verdict of every case is recorded next to the coarse expectation.
Mechanisms the current verifier does not catch are listed under 'excluded_cases' rather than silently dropped.
